decision: evidence only, not packaged, endpoints stay gated
summary: Published 672-hour point estimates meet the numeric coverage, skill, crossing, and finiteness checks (maximum absolute coverage error 0.018155, pinball skill 0.930441 to 0.944255). The evidence-bundle and feature-availability gates are not passed. The candidate is evidence only: it is not packaged, and the prediction endpoints stay gated. The v1.4 rejection is unchanged.

calibration_coverage_after.note: chosen grid multipliers applied, on the calibration window only

calibration_coverage_before.note: v1.4 fixed shrinkage factors (q50 x0.40, q90 x0.90, q95 x0.90, q99 x0.55) applied to the same calibration-window base offsets

calibration.grid: multiplier in [0.50, 1.50] step 0.01, minimizing |empirical coverage - target coverage| on the calibration window only; ties resolve to the smaller multiplier

gates.requirement: finite outputs for every evaluation row

gates.observed: published aggregate summary only; hourly inputs and the model artifact were not archived
gates.requirement: immutable metadata, evaluation, and backtest bundle sufficient to recompute every gate result from its inputs

gates.observed: evaluation used realized ERA5 weather for the target hour; production requests an Open-Meteo forecast
gates.requirement: serving features built only from information available at prediction time

data_provenance: Official ERCOT system-load archives (NP6-346-CD) joined with pinned Open-Meteo ERA5 weather (four zones, fixed weights from 2019-2024 load). Load segment A: 2019-01-01 to 2024-12-31 (52,602 joined rows). Load segment B: 2026-08-28 to 2026-11-02 23:00 (1,603 joined rows). Pinned ERA5 had not yet published 2026-11-03 at run time, so the six load hours 2026-11-03 00:00-05:00 are unmatched and excluded by the inner join; they lie outside every frozen window and do not affect any reported number. Model and calibration parameters were frozen before the evaluation window was touched.
reproduction: python -m training.ercot.download_historical_weather_period --start 2026-10-31 --end 2026-11-02 --output-dir training_data/ercot_weather_era5_2026; join combined load with the two weather directories (zone weights from <=2024 rows); audit per segment; build features per segment and concatenate to training_runs/ercot_v1/features.csv; python -m training.ercot.train_quantile_model --features training_runs/ercot_v1/features.csv --calibration-mode grid --training-end 2025-01-01 --calibration-start 2026-09-07 --calibration-end 2026-10-04 --evaluation-start 2026-10-05 --evaluation-end 2026-11-01 --model-version ercot-lag-residual-gbt-v1.5-candidate

recomputed_from_published_aggregates.authority: Derived from the published aggregates in evidence/ercot_v1_5/measurements.json. Not recomputed from hourly rows.
recomputed_from_published_aggregates.power_model: IID binomial. Hourly errors are dependent, so this is a sample-size illustration and not a grid-operations sample size. True coverage 0.96 sits on the 0.03 gate boundary, so this probability stays near one half as n grows.

cross_window_q50_skill_illustration.meaning: 1 - (v1.5 q50 pinball / v1.4-window implied baseline pinball). The two pinballs are from different hours. This is not a measured skill on the 672-hour window.

limitations: Evaluation uses realized ERA5 weather for the target hour. Production weather is an Open-Meteo forecast. The published scores omit weather-forecast error and are an optimistic upper bound on forecast-weather performance. That train/serve skew fails feature availability and blocks packaging.

The evidence bundle published with the result was an aggregate JSON. Hourly inputs, baseline predictions, and the model artifact were not archived, so the evidence-bundle gate is not passed. Derived identities below are checked; the primary measurements are transcribed.

The preregistration commit 2fcf2c9b528c1e309fc9912687466ad69d7899c2 is dated 2026-11-05 03:11:19 PT, after the evaluation window closed. It is a retrospective freeze. Git does not show whether the series was inspected before that commit; the results commit is 2026-11-08.

At n=672 the published coverages imply 29 Q95 exceedances and 8 Q99 exceedances. Under an IID binomial model, P(Q99 gate fails | true coverage 0.96) is about 0.52. The point-estimate gate is unchanged.

The reported skill uses a seasonal baseline fit only on timestamps before 2025-01-01. v1.4's published q50 MAE and skill imply a baseline pinball near 1276 on the v1.4 window, versus 2312.438609 here. Those windows differ, so 0.93 and v1.4's 0.76-0.84 are not the same comparison.
The v1.4 candidate remains rejected. No failed v1.4 gate is relabeled as a pass, and the 0.03 threshold is not moved.
GERT is decision-support research and must not be used for autonomous grid control.

A regeneration of the hourly rows and model artifact was attempted on 2026-11-11 and stopped. ERCOT NP6-346-CD, the frozen load source, returned HTTP 401 without a subscription key. No credential was opened and the public native-load archives were not substituted. The evidence-bundle gate stays not passed.
